products.title: The Bard: Tales from Aévan: Book One

dialogue.user: Thanks for these recommendations! All three seem to fit my genre and quality preferences. Could you tell me more about "The Bard: Tales from Aévan: Book One"? I’m interested in a brief description of its story and what makes it stand out as a fantasy novel.
dialogue.agent:
"The Bard: Tales from Aévan: Book One" is a high fantasy adventure set in the world of Aévan. The story follows Magnus Alexander, a guardsman in the Astorian Royal Guard Corps, whose life was shattered sixteen years ago when the leader of the Emerald Blood Bandit Guild, Cade, murdered Magnus’s wife and kidnapped his daughter. With news of Cade’s reemergence, Magnus, his former protégé Neoma, and an assassin named Elias embark on a dangerous journey to seek revenge and rescue his daughter. The book promises darkness, intrigue, and a quest for closure, standing out for its classic fantasy themes of adventure, redemption, and justice.

Would you like to see what customers had to say about it?

result.features: The Bard is a high fantasy adventure set in the world of Aévan. Magnus Alexander is a guardsman for the Astorian Royal Guard Corps. Sixteen years ago his life was torn apart by the notorious leader of the Emerald Blood Bandit Guild, Cade. After Cade murdered Magnus's wife and kidnapped his daughter, he disappeared without a trace. Now, news has come to Astoria that Cade has been seen for the first time in sixteen years. Magnus, along with his former protégé, Neoma, and the Astorian assassin, Elias, takes on his most dangerous adventure in order to avenge his wife and save his daughter. With darkness looming over Aévan and the threat of the Emerald Blood on their backs, these three will set out to finish the story that began when Magnus's happy life came to an end.
